gold.analysis: The current market dynamics suggest a bearish momentum, as the EMA stack continues to slope downward, reinforcing the overall downtrend. We anticipate a potential range contraction during the Asian session, which may provide a liquidity sweep opportunity for strategic entry points. A successful entry will require a clear understanding of the market's liquidity profile and a well-executed trade plan. Our macro bearish bias remains intact, targeting a key support level in the vicinity of 3200.
